title: Kombination und Erweiterung / dark background
slide_intent: Use a subdued scene and one focus so a dark graphic composition remains readable.
strategic_value: A gray skyline with a red focal building can keep DB destination imagery distinct without competing accents.
demonstration: The dark tab shows gray combined landmarks against Cold Black with one red tower.
practical_value: Build the combined background in the defined dark-ground grays and select one red or lilac focus.
